notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0003] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: Use `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` to normalize any incoming datetime before comparing or doing arithmetic on it, rather than assuming tz-awareness.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Raise BillingError with snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) with a snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount", matching ledgerly/payments.py.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 3x, 1 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0004] Use money helpers for amounts: Convert monetary inputs with `ledgerly.money.to_money` and round results with `ledgerly.money.round_money` (ROUND_HALF_UP to the cent) instead of floats or builtin `round`.
  (learned from task E05 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
